newsitem.title: USA: S&P buys Argentina's Risk Annalysis.
newsitem.headline: S&P buys Argentina's Risk Annalysis.

text.p: McGraw-Hill Cos Inc's Standard & Poor's Ratings Services on Wednesday said it has acquired all outstanding shares of Argentina rating service Risk Annalysis.
S&P did not release details of the deal other than it was made for "an undisclosed cash amount."

Risk Annalysis is the leading Argentine rating service and currently rates more than 100 entities in the country, S&P said. The two companies in 1995 signed an affiliation agreement covering technical assistance, criteria development and marketing support.
Harold McGraw III, president and chief operating officer of The McGraw-Hill Cos, said the move was made to expand local analytical capabilities.
Risk Annalysis is based in Buenos Aires.
